claims.claim_text: If we had 10 interventions in 600 seconds, we would have an autonomy value of (1 −10 · 6 / 600 ) · 100 = 90%.
For a typical drive in Monmouth County NJ from our office in Holmdel to Atlantic Highlands, we are autonomous approximately 98% of the time.
claims.normalized_text: Autonomy during typical drive in Monmouth County NJ is approximately 98%.

claims.claim_text: We also drove 10 miles on the Garden State Parkway (a multi-lane divided highway with on and off ramps) with zero intercepts.
claims.normalized_text: Drove 10 miles on Garden State Parkway with zero intercepts.
